patch.value: The session-role dimension is wired to a boolean child-session flag, so every nested claude-code invocation records the role literally as "1" and fleet analytics will group real work under a meaningless label

Measured on 2026-08-03 against pm 2026.8.3.

The claude-code harness descriptor in src/core/shared/author.ts declares provenance_environment_keys.role = ['CLAUDE_CODE_CHILD_SESSION']. That variable is a boolean marker meaning 'this invocation is a nested session'; its value in a live session is the literal string '1'. The resolver treats any non-blank value as the role observation, so a fresh mutation on 2026-08-03 records agent_provenance.role = {value: '1', source: 'environment'}.

This reads as legitimate provenance. The source is 'environment', which is the same source category a genuinely declared role would carry, so no consumer can distinguish a real role from this artifact by inspecting the entry. Fleet attribution analytics group by role; a permanently immutable population of entries labelled role '1' is worse than a population labelled null, because null is honest about absence and '1' is not.

The wiring appears to be a category error introduced while closing the gap that role had no descriptor key on any harness. Filling the slot with the only role-adjacent variable the harness exports satisfies a coverage metric while defeating the purpose of the dimension. If the nested-session fact is worth recording it deserves its own dimension with its own name and a boolean value domain.

Related but distinct: whether a declared resolver that fails is distinguishable from a dimension a harness cannot supply is its own finding. This one is the inverse - a resolver that succeeds and records a value that means nothing.

Scope is the role dimension wiring and the general rule that a descriptor key must match the value domain of the dimension it feeds.

No provenance dimension is sourced from an environment key whose value domain is boolean or presence-only; Each descriptor key declares the dimension value domain it is expected to carry, and a value outside that domain is refused rather than recorded; The nested-session fact, if worth recording, is recorded in a dimension whose name says what it means rather than being smuggled into role; A corpus check reports zero provenance values that are bare booleans or single digits across all dimensions
pm 2026.8.3, claude-code harness with CLAUDE_CODE_CHILD_SESSION=1, Linux
Run a pm mutation from a nested/child claude-code session and read agent_provenance.role on the newest history entry.
role is either a descriptive session role the operator declared, or null when the harness publishes no role.

role is {value: "1", source: "environment"}. The claude-code descriptor maps the role dimension to CLAUDE_CODE_CHILD_SESSION, which is a presence/boolean flag whose value is the string "1", not a role name.

author: harness:claude-code
message: Wire role-dimension defect into provenance lineage and placeholder-value data-quality class
